Name: Marriage Dialogue Unlocker Tool
Author: vicarchive
Description:
[i][size=4]>> OVERVIEW[/size][/i]
Do you actually talk to your spouse? Do they say the same stuff over and over? Is that annoying the hell out of you? Me too.

This mod allows for more dialogue to be added via Content Patcher, into the MarriageDialogue.xnb or MarriageDialogue<spouse>.xnb. By using the defined prefixes below, you can add basically infinite dialogue for your spouse... and it's not just for the Marriage Dialogue stuff either, you can add more entries for things that are in the StringsFromCSFiles (ex: your spouse watered the crops)! Anything your spouse says that is related to marriage can now be changed from Content Patcher!!!!

[i][size=4]>> COMPATIBILITY NOTES[/size][/i]
This mod works with SDVE or any other expansion mod. This should also work with any Content Patcher mods, as well as any preexisting (including marriage) dialogue mods.

For those who are more technically savvy, this mod postfixes the marriageDialogueReference constructor, so if a mod does not modify it then it should be fine.

[i]Restrictions:[/i]
This mod was made with 1.6.15, it may not be compatible with earlier or later versions.
This mod may not be compatible with polyamory mods.

[i][size=4]>> OTHER STUFF[/size][/i]
It is entirely safe to delete (-> remove entries with Content Patcher) dialogue entries from either of the two XNBs as long as you have dialogue for each prefix. Missing dialogue will earn you a "..." ingame.

I suggest you do not remove entries from StringsFromCSFiles since these are used as a failsafe.

[i][size=4]>> PREFIX GUIDE[/size][/i]
Below is the list of prefixes the mod will recognize and which dialogues they correspond to. Please make sure you're familiar with the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Dialogue#Marriage_dialogue]dialogue prefix options already in the game[/url]﻿ so this list makes the most sense.

MarriageDialogue keys:
[spoiler]<season>_<day>
<season>_<spousename>
Rainy_Night
Rainy_Day
Indoor_Night
Indoor_Day
Outdoor
Good
Neutral
Bad
OneKid
TwoKids
spouseRoom
funLeave
jobLeave
funReturn
jobReturn
patio:[/spoiler]
StringsFromCSFiles (new) keys:
[spoiler][b]Obstacle[/b]: Spouse could not pathfind
[b]displeasedGeneral[/b]: Higher chance to show up at low hearts
[b]displeasedGendered[/b]: General but Gendered
[b]displeasedFem[/b]: Female spouse specific dialogue
[b]Adoption_Obstacle[/b]: Could not pathfind, waiting on adoption
[b]Adoption_Name[/b]: Adoption, refers to farmer by name
[b]Adoption_Endearment[/b]: Adoption, refers to farmer with endearment
[b]Pregnancy_Obstacle[/b]: Could not pathfind, spouse is pregnant
[b]Pregnancy_Endearment[/b]: Pregnancy, refers to farmer with endearment
[b]Pregnancy_Name[/b]: Pregnancy, refers to farmer by name
[b]Expecting_Obstacle[/b]: Could not pathfind, farmer is pregnant
[b]Expecting_Endearment[/b]: Expecting, refers to farmer with endearment
[b]Expecting_Name[/b]: Expecting, refers to farmer by name
[b]ParentObstacle_One[/b]: Could not pathfind, one child
[b]ParentObstacle_Two[/b]: Could not pathfind, two children
Breakfast_Nevermind: Could not pathfind, spouse wanted to make breakfast
[b]WateredCrops[/b]: Spouse watered crops
[b]PetBowl_Multiple[/b]: Spouse watered multiple pet bowls
[b]PetBowl_One[/b]: Spouse watered one pet bowl
[b]Greeting_WorkDone[/b]: Greeting when spouse did farm work
[b]Greeting_NoWork[/b]: Greeting when spouse did not do farm work
[b]Sprinkler[/b]: Spouse wanted to water crops but player has sprinklers on every plant tile
[b]FeedAnimals[/b]: Spouse fed the animals
[b]RepairFences[/b]: Spouse repaired the fences
[b]Furniture_Introduce[/b]: First furniture dialogue ("How does it look?")
[b]Furniture_Show[/b]: Second furniture dialogue ("I bought this recently")
[b]Furniture_Obstacle[/b]: Could not pathfind, wanted to place furniture
[b]Change_Wallpaper[/b]: Spouse changed wallpaper
[b]Change_Flooring[/b]: Spouse changed flooring
Furniture_Reminisce: unsure
Reminisce: unsure[/spoiler]
I have some more documentation on these on the mod's Github (mirror tab).

Enjoy <3

Downloads.Description: Unzip to the Mods folder. Use Content Patcher to add dialogue entries as per the prefix section and examples and the mod will pull it up ingame. Enable verbose logging to see mod logs.
